values.meaning: short cooldown before UPGRADE!!! can be recast (and the delay placed on it if manually ended)
values.binNote: no matching data value found in the sheet for R; this is the infobox 'static' recast-timer field only

mechanics.claim: UPGRADE!!! empowers Heimerdinger's next basic ability for an additional effect, consumed upon cast.
mechanics.quote: Heimerdinger can empower his next ability to apply an additional effect.

mechanics.claim: Empowered abilities have the same cooldowns as their basic forms but deal modified damage and cost no mana.
mechanics.quote: These empowered abilities have the same {{sti|cooldowns}} as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not cost mana.

mechanics.claim: Casting an empowered ability consumes the empowerment and places UPGRADE!!! on its full cooldown.
mechanics.quote: consuming the empowerment upon cast and placing ''UPGRADE!!!'' on full cooldown

mechanics.claim: UPGRADE!!!'s cooldown starts only after an empowered ability is actually used, not on toggle.
mechanics.quote: Starts after using an empowered ability

mechanics.claim: Toggling UPGRADE!!! off removes the empowerment and puts the affected ability on its own static cooldown, with no mana refund.
mechanics.quote: can be toggled off to remove the empowerment and place the ability on its static {{sti|cooldown}}

mechanics.claim: No mana compensation is made when UPGRADE!!! is toggled on and off; Heimerdinger loses 100 mana each time.
mechanics.quote: '''Heimerdinger''' will lose {{as|100 mana}} each time he toggles the ability on and off

mechanics.claim: Toggling the empowerment on does not count as an ability activation for on-cast effects, but consuming it for an empowered basic ability does.
mechanics.quote: Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
